status: source transformations documented; returning-production denominators and historical publication timestamps are not independently reconstructed

common.scope: Inherited season-level provider priors, numerically coerced and forward-filled within each team-season. The experiment verifies constant roster/coach state within team-season. Historical publication time is reconstructed rather than independently archived.
common.missingness: If no prior or current finite same-team-season source exists, remain missing. Duplicate canonical fingerprint-key records are averaged before forward filling. Experiment frozen inputs remain authoritative.
common.minimum_sample_rule: One source team-season value, or at least one matched prior coach-season for the coach aggregate.
common.garbage_time_handling: No new play-level filtering. These are provider season/career summaries; do not interpret them as locally reconstructed regular-season-only player production.
common.availability_rule: Retained source semantics and the hash-bound source_semantics_audit.json govern this authorized inherited baseline; static invariance is not proof of archived preseason publication.

roster_return_percent_p_p_a.units: provider PPA share (dimensionless signed ratio scale; retained as returned, no division by 100)
roster_return_percent_p_p_a.positive_negative_meaning: Signed provider returning-production share. This is not a probability and observed values may be below zero or above one; do not clamp to [0,1]. The raw API denominator has not been independently reconstructed.
roster_return_percent_p_p_a.film_intuition: Returning all production as reported by the provider; production mix and denominator behavior matter, not just headcount.

roster_return_rushing_usage.positive_negative_meaning: Larger means more provider-reported returning rushing involvement. Observed values in this artifact span zero to one; that observation is not an imposed clipping rule.
roster_return_rushing_usage.film_intuition: Continuity of rushing involvement, distinct from the efficiency or scoring value of that involvement.

roster_return_total_rushing_p_p_a.positive_negative_meaning: Signed provider returning rushing production; negative indicates net negative reported scoring value. It is a total, not points per rush.
roster_return_total_rushing_p_p_a.film_intuition: Amount of prior rushing production returning, combining involvement and value.

roster_talent.units: provider team talent composite rating points
roster_talent.positive_negative_meaning: Larger provider composite indicates more rated talent. Zero is retained as supplied and is not proof of an absence of football ability.
roster_talent.film_intuition: Roster recruiting profile rather than observed on-field production; the provider composite is not refit locally.

coach_career_seasons.prior_filter: matching_prior_hist_year contains numeric history years strictly below target_season for the matched coach; raw_weekly_builder explicitly requests cutoff_mode=lt. One distinct year counts once, regardless of duplicate historical records. Empty aggregate produces no career row and joins as missing.
coach_career_seasons.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative historical experience count; higher means more recorded prior seasons, not necessarily better coaching.
coach_career_seasons.film_intuition: Experience proxy for the source-selected coach; this does not establish current-season staff continuity or coaching changes.
